doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Parents' work and his younger sister Mariette
summary: The family labored at the café; his sister Mariette was born in 1929.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Could you talk about your parents? What were their jobs or occupations?
Occupation? They tried to operate that café, and my mother, you know, we had a sister was born, too. She’s still alive—Mariette.

Younger sister. Six, seven years. She was born in ’29, and I was born in ’22. And now we Skype, you know. We have a ball. [laughs] And so, and they were just… there was enough work to do with operating that little Kop Knuff [?]. [laughs]
